policy_assertion: Public layer remains index/policy/template/manifest only; no public URL release.
note: public URL exposure is blocked unless reviewed through source-link and public-index gates

policy_assertion: No case detail, testimony, image, route, live referral, support path, or capacity claim is released.
note: public-surface scanners, semantic parity, and source near-miss checks jointly enforce the non-release posture

policy_assertion: Candidate-level public export is eligibility-led and fail-closed.
note: renderer depends on eligibility ledger, shared semantic template policy, and parity/consistency checks

policy_assertion: Indigenous data-governance and takedown/reclassification remain required before expansion of MMIWG2S+ or Indigenous family-led material.
note: governance documents and ledgers must exist and remain consistent

policy_assertion: Current revision surfaces cannot silently drift from the manifest.
note: front-door and JSON revision fields are audited

policy_assertion: Generated reports are not trusted unless their generator, inputs, hashes, and rebuild readiness are recorded.
note: provenance and rebuild-readiness reports gate generated artifacts

policy_assertion: Schemas, mirrors, and field definitions must remain explicit and zero-backlog.
note: mirror and schema backlogs are release-blocking

policy_assertion: Package tools and paths must be inventoried and traceable to release gates or explicit helper status.
Selected validators must prove they fail on known-bad temporary package copies.
note: controlled mutation tests must all pass

policy_assertion: Package handoff identity is not trusted unless archive member paths, Unicode filenames, and root/manifest/refresh/checksum identity close.
note: archive-member namespace, Unicode path safety, and package identity closure must pass before handoff

policy_assertion: Handoff safety now requires explicit dependency-cycle clarity, use-limit notice visibility, and classification of every current CSV surface.
note: cycle, notice, and current-surface registry gates must pass before handoff

policy_assertion: Shared audit helper adoption is gated and report-shape continuity is checked before handoff.
note: helper adoption gate must pass before handoff
